tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Get swap quotes for exchanging one crypto asset to another. Returns available quotes with exchange rates, fees, and estimated output amounts. API key is optional.

amount.description: Amount to swap in human-readable format (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5 BTC)

tools.name: start_dca_swap
tools.description: Start a DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) cross-chain swap that splits into multiple sub-swaps over time. Returns the deposit address. API key is optional.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address on the target chain

refundAddress.description: Refund address on the source chain, used if minimum price cannot be met

numberOfChunks.description: Number of sub-swaps for DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging). Values below 1 are treated as 1.

chunkIntervalBlocks.description: Optional delay between DCA sub-swaps in state-chain blocks (1 block = 6 seconds). Defaults to 2 blocks (12 seconds) when omitted or negative; 0 with more than one chunk becomes 2. A schedule longer than Chainflip's limit is shortened.

minimumPrice.description: Optional minimum accepted price as a destination-per-source ratio (e.g., for a btc.btc to eth.eth swap, 28.5 means 1 BTC gets at least 28.5 ETH). When omitted, automatically calculated from current pool prices with 2% slippage tolerance. Set to 0 to accept any price.

livePriceSlippageTolerancePercent.description: Optional live price protection: how far, in percent (0 to 100, at most 2 decimals, e.g. 0.5), the execution price may fall below Chainflip's oracle price before a sub-swap is retried and the rest refunded. Use a quote's recommendedLivePriceSlippageTolerancePercent. When either asset has no oracle price on Chainflip, live price protection is omitted and the swap proceeds without it. When omitted, Chainflip's default protection for the pair applies.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check the status of a swap by its ID. Returns the current swap state including deposit detection, swap progress, and egress information.

swapId.description: The swap ID returned by start_swap or start_dca_swap

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List all available swap assets and their details including ticker, network, direction, decimals, minimum amounts, and current USD prices.

tools.name: start_swap
tools.description: Start a cross-chain swap. Returns the deposit address where you should send your source asset. API key is optional.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address on the target chain

refundAddress.description: Refund address on the source chain, used if minimum price cannot be met

minimumPrice.description: Optional minimum accepted price as a destination-per-source ratio (e.g., for a btc.btc to eth.eth swap, 28.5 means 1 BTC gets at least 28.5 ETH). When omitted, automatically calculated from current pool prices with 2% slippage tolerance. Set to 0 to accept any price.

livePriceSlippageTolerancePercent.description: Optional live price protection: how far, in percent (0 to 100, at most 2 decimals, e.g. 0.5), the execution price may fall below Chainflip's oracle price before the swap is retried and then refunded. Use a quote's recommendedLivePriceSlippageTolerancePercent. When either asset has no oracle price on Chainflip, live price protection is omitted and the swap proceeds without it. When omitted, Chainflip's default protection for the pair applies.

tools.name: get_native_quotes
tools.description: Get swap quotes for exchanging one crypto asset to another using native (smallest unit) amounts. Returns available quotes with exchange rates, fees, and estimated output amounts. Use this when you have amounts in native units (e.g., satoshis for BTC, wei for ETH). API key is optional.

amount.description: Amount to swap in native units (e.g., '100000000' for 1 BTC in satoshis)
